title: Magnetization of Nuclear-Spin-Polarization-Induced Quantum Ring
abstract: Properties of a Nuclear-Spin-Polarization-Induced Quantum Ring (NSPI QR) are studied theoretically. In the proposed system a local nuclear spin polarization creates an effective hyperfine field which confines the electrons with the spins opposite to the hyperfine field to the regions of maximal nuclear spin polarization. We investigate the electron energy spectrum and the magnetic response of NSPI QR and their evolution in time due to the nuclear spin diffusion and relaxation.
